scripts.build: npm run build -w @checkiq/contracts && npm run build -w @checkiq/api && npm run build -w @checkiq/web && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @checkiq/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @checkiq/api && npm run typecheck -w @checkiq/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @checkiq/api && npm run lint -w @checkiq/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @checkiq/api" "npm run dev -w @checkiq/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @checkiq/api && npm run test -w @checkiq/web
